newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-GLAMORGAN WIN TOSS, PUT AUSTRALIA IN TO BAT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-GLAMORGAN WIN TOSS, PUT AUSTRALIA IN TO BAT.

text.p: Glamorgan won the toss and put
Australia in to bat in their three-day cricket match on
Glamorgan - Steve James, Hugh Morris, Adrian Dale, Matthew
Maynard (captain), Tony Cottey, Mike Powell, Gary Butcher, Colin
Metson, Darren Thomas, Dean Cosker, Owen Parkin.
Australia - Matthew Elliott, Mark Taylor (captain), Michael
Slater, Greg Blewett, Ricky Ponting, Justin Langer, Michael
Bevan, Darren Berry, Brendon Julian, Paul Reiffel, Mark
